plan.anchor: ### RM1-P3-A｜三层 scope 与 generated capability requirement

platformOtp.p3a: Only remove any existing OTP testCode response exposure and establish server-side capability framework integration; do not create a mobile OTP endpoint, token/receipt storage, or UI behavior.
platformOtp.p6: Any new platform mobile OTP protocol or UI remains P6 and requires Dexter acceptance of RM1-IA-01.

publicWrites.finiteException: The eight public invitation/password-reset writes remain in the dynamic mutating-operation denominator. Their requirement resolves from server-validated invitation/reset token protocol and owner invariant, never an authenticated workspace session, page key, URL-derived role, or client capability literal.

reviewCadence.reviewBoundary: Complete P3-A, P3-B and P3-C serially with each predecessor package-exit PASS, then provide one unified implementation review package to Dexter and Claude.
nonWaivers: P3-B cannot begin until RM1-U02 P3-A package-exit PASS
P3-C cannot begin until RM1-U03 P3-B package-exit PASS
each package retains its own actual changed-path/receipt/source-disposition equality
the unified review is a fresh independent implementation review and Claude handoff covering all three packages

actualChangeSurfaceCorrection.reason: The approved P3-A action explicitly owns generator, CapabilityRequirement compiler, typed resolver registry, Problem mapping, every mutating-operation template and owner recheck. The manifest's three broad source roots omit their existing generator, generated artifacts, owner implementation and focused-test paths; this correction makes those already-approved implementation dependencies enumerable without changing frozen design bytes or adding a Journey/UI behavior.

generate server, operations and typed resolver catalogs from authoritative registry
single requirement ID per current mutating operation
retain UI catalog as display input without authorization authority
owner-public command rechecks and typed resolver integration
generated catalog consumption and typed Problem mapping

exitRules: P3-A uses a new RM1-U02 baseline and never reuses P0 receipt or prompt-recovery evidence

the dynamic mutating-operation inventory covers every current public/admin write without a handwritten count
